name: shrink
description: Token-efficient, low-loss context compaction for Claude Code: a script prunes the transcript, Haiku distills it instead of the session model, and a recall tool answers exact questions about the compacted conversation from a local archive.

mode.title: Shrink mode
mode.description: haiku: Haiku writes the state of work from a pruned digest. code: no model call at the shrink (facts only).

shrinkModel.title: Shrink and recall model
shrinkModel.description: Model alias or id for the state of work and for recall answers.

handoffDir.title: Handoff folder
handoffDir.description: Where handoffs, archives and index shards go. Empty: <project's Claude folder>/handoffs, next to the transcript.

digestChars.title: Digest cap (chars, override)
digestChars.description: Off by default (0): the token budget below decides what Haiku reads. Set it to cap the digest anyway; older lines are dropped first.

haikuBudgetTokens.title: Haiku budget (tokens)
haikuBudgetTokens.description: Most input tokens one Haiku call may take, estimated at 2 chars per token (measured 2.0-2.4). A larger shrink is split into up to 6 parts plus a merge; recall reads only what fits. Keep it under 100000, where Haiku moves to its higher price.

stateEffort.title: State writer effort
stateEffort.description: Reasoning effort for the state of work: low, medium, high or xhigh. Medium by default: in a replay of 13 recorded shrinks, high made no fewer errors at about twice the output tokens. A timed-out call above medium is retried once at medium.

mapEffort.title: Part note-taker effort
mapEffort.description: Reasoning effort for the note-takers on older parts of a large shrink.

recallEffort.title: Recall reader effort
recallEffort.description: Reasoning effort for the recall reader.

factsBudgetChars.title: Facts budget (chars)
factsBudgetChars.description: Size limit of the exact facts in the handoff message.

tailChars.title: Kept tail (chars)
tailChars.description: Size limit of the last messages kept word for word after a shrink.

recallScope.title: Recall scope
recallScope.description: session: only this session's shrunk conversation. project: also this project's other sessions.

thresholdWarnAbove.title: Warn above threshold
thresholdWarnAbove.description: At session start, toast if the auto-compact threshold is missing or above this many tokens.
